cs.t: I use the Seiki 42" 4k TV which hovers around $300 ( http://camelcamelcamel.com/Seiki-SE42UM-42-Inch-Ultra-Black/... ) as my primary development monitor.  As a TV, color-correct, or a gaming monitor, it's rather dross, but as a wall of pixels to work on code, I will never go back to anything smaller.  Ever.
